glosses: die Struktur eines Mylonits betreffend, in der Art eines Mylonits

translations.source_sense_description: Geologie: die Struktur eines Mylonits betreffend, in der Art eines Mylonits

examples.text: Fibrous strain fringes up to ~12 mm long surrounding large (~5 mm) pyrites were collected from mylonitic carbonate-rich slates of Aptian age [~110 million years ago (Ma)] in the immediate hanging wall of a north-directed thrust of the Northern Pyrenees near Lourdes, France.
